method.controls: Full main/jib; suggested-sheet scan updated each simulation second; no current, engine, reef, or contacts; neutral helm. Trim maximizes instantaneous empirical forward drive, not global VMG.
method.recommendedTrim: Exact production suggestedSheet at every integer apparent wind angle from 90 to 180 degrees.

note: Diagnostic of the current empirical model, not an externally calibrated sailing polar.
